xianwan.status: implemented with focused real-command checks and measured routine verification
xianwan.input: zero physical cards; use-only normal Slash or own Slash-defense Dodge; never generic response-only conversion
xianwan.cost: actual unchained to chained for Dodge, actual chained to unchained for Slash; freeze typed payment on owning frame and drain native character-state children before issuing the requested use
xianwan.entryEvidence: PRi.activeMode ACTIVE|PASSIVE|ASK; cardUseType UCt.USE; tap>0 selects SHA, tap==0 selects SHAN. Active Slash checks gf.CanUseSha; ordinary IXt target selector retains native distance and target legality
xianwan.excludedResponseEvidence: PRi excludes NANMAN/JUEDOU for SHA and WANJIAN/HUJIA for SHAN; use-only requested Slash such as BorrowedSword remains distinct from pure Response
xianwan.additionalClientGates: IsNotAllowByShouFu (also WangShi2020), DATA_FUHUNPO, CannotUseCardBySeatState; Dodge additionally checks DATA_FENDI
xianwan.inference: A prevented entry or forced-chain refusal to unchain cannot pay the stated real state-change cost. Refuse before issuing a card; do not make a no-op state mutation count as payment. No dedicated official XianWan/QianJie/JieYing cross-FAQ located.

xuanbei.status: implemented with focused real-command checks and measured routine verification
xuanbei.activation: owner own Play once per phase; choose one other living participant with an eligible region entity
xuanbei.selection: owner selects exactly one foreign owned physical entity; current eLi declares NORMAL|EQUIP|DECIDE|REGION and mS explicitly checks Hand/Equipment/Judgment counts. Preserve hidden-hand privacy
xuanbei.actorAndDirection: the selected foreign participant is the real ordinary Slash actor/provider; chosen entity is its sole physical material from original location; initial target and Draw beneficiary are the skill owner
xuanbei.forcedUse: current text says command them to use, not they may use. eLi presents owner card selection and has no foreign decline path; do not introduce an optional refusal
xuanbei.distanceAndQuota: only distance is explicitly unlimited; retain native prohibition/target legality and actual use/quota rules. Foreign out-of-turn instructed Use is not an own-Play quota opportunity. No text authorizes unlimited-use or quota refund
xuanbei.completion: wait for exact native Use and all material/equipment/response/HP/Dying/completed children; then Draw2 if that exact Use caused real DamageApplied to the owner, otherwise Draw1. Rewards do not depend on unrelated concurrent damage or total match damage
xuanbei.inference: exact owning-use damage proof, once receipt and post-child reward are engine mappings of the current wording and June 2022 then-clause, not independently verified live server rulings

openQuestions.detail: No dedicated primary FAQ found. Client PRi reads tap state but has no explicit QianJie/JieYing payment-success branch. Require the actual requested state transition to succeed; retain exact once cost across children.

openQuestions.topic: XuanBei illegal instructed Use after payment or target loss
openQuestions.status: not officially adjudicated in bounded research
openQuestions.detail: No detailed primary ruling found for actor/target dying, use prohibition or material loss during equipment-leave children. Implement a documented native legality boundary and one final reward decision; do not invent foreign decline or retry payment.

openQuestions.topic: XuanBei unusual REGION cards and movement protection
openQuestions.detail: NORMAL/EQUIP/DECIDE directly prove HEJ; REGION is also set. Whether every special region/pile entity is selectable depends on generic client region filtering/server permissions; do not silently equate it to all public persistent piles.

openQuestions.topic: XuanBei per-use quota under extra Play or instructed use
openQuestions.status: engine mapping pending final root contract
openQuestions.detail: Only distance exemption is printed. Preserve native real Use semantics; do not import the old requestedSlash helper quota bypass without justification.

openQuestions.topic: XianWan state-child changes or source loss after real cost
openQuestions.detail: Once paid, no second chain mutation on cold resume. Whether a source lost before issuance should cancel or continue must follow a single explicit paid-continuation contract.
